_about: Invented sample of an optional story bank, in the format produced by linkedin-story-interviewer. This skill only reads it; it works without one. All people and companies are fictional.

entries.title: Ranges back-tested before launch
entries.detail: The delivery range was back-tested against two quarters of deliveries. Eight in ten shipments landed inside it network-wide; the two mountain lanes ran at about six in ten.

figure.measures: shipments arriving inside the quoted range

entries.title: Range model started as a spreadsheet
entries.detail: The first version was a spreadsheet fed by two years of delivery scans; planners later rebuilt it inside the scheduling tool.

entries.title: Dispatcher retraining
entries.detail: Retraining dispatchers to read out the range took longer than planned. Hours not yet confirmed.

sample_lines: The range is not a hedge.
